literal: Fulfilled-word people's greatness on earth hidden-words having-shown will-leave.
translation: The greatness of men whose words are always fulfilled is revealed to the world by their profound, hidden words.
modern: சொன்ன சொல் தவறாத பெரியோர்களின் பெருமையை, இவ்வுலகில் அவர்கள் கூறிய ஆழமான மறைமொழிகளே காட்டிவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet explains how the true power of great ascetics is recognized in the world. The phrase 'நிறைமொழி' (niṟaimoḻi) refers to words that are full of truth and bound to be fulfilled, indicating the speakers' unwavering integrity and spiritual weight. 'மறைமொழி' (maṟaimoḻi) means hidden or secret words, representing profound sayings that carry deep, unseen power. The couplet states that the greatness of such people is proven on earth by the lasting impact and truth of their profound words, which clearly demonstrate their immense power to the world.
